prompt: The Open/Closed Principle states that software entities should be…
choices: Open for modification, closed for extension
Open for extension, closed for modification
Open to all packages, closed to reflection
Closed at compile time, open at runtime
explanation: OCP: you should be able to add new behavior by adding new code (extension), not by changing existing code (modification). Example: use Strategy pattern so new algorithms can be added without touching the Context class.
